QuestInfo.name: How to find friends
QuestInfo.0: The Maple Administrator says she wants to tell you how to find friends.
QuestInfo.1: Try finding friends to make your MapleStory experience even better!
QuestInfo.2: Hooray! You've added a friend. Make more friends to enrich your MapleStory experience.

1.0: Have you found a friend yet? Open the Friends window (hotkey: R) and press the Find Friends button to search for friends...or use the Friend Finder Megaphone!
